Bridge Field


PokemonItemsMax Raid Battles


Wild Area?: Yes
North Exit: Stony Wilderness
South Exit: Motostoke Riverbank

Bridge Field is an area connecting the southern and northern parts of the Wild Area and has the bridges from Route 5 and Route 7 go above it.

Pokémon Nursery
In the eastern part of the area is the Pokémon Nursery where, for 500P per Pokémon, you can place Pokémon into the Nursery in the hope of generating a Pokémon Egg.

Digging Duo
In the western part of the route you'll find the Digging Duo who in exchange for 500 Watts, will find various items for you by digging itno the cliffside. Click here for further details
